MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 15
   C. 9
   D. 6

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 10

14. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
